record.question: The maximum number of members in the Council of Ministers is determined by which Constitutional Amendment?
record.explanation: Answer B: 91st Constitutional Amendment. The 91st Amendment caps the Union Council of Ministers at 15% of Lok Sabha membership and state councils at 15% of assembly membership. Reference: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
